name: a bare address holding a balanced pair of parentheses
why: The same walk out of the allowlist written without a link's brackets. A renderer autolinks the whole address and lands on github.com/attacker/evil, while a reader of bare addresses stops at the first ')' and leaves an allowed prefix behind. A fact writes a link as [text](url) and nothing else, so a bare address is refused rather than read.
fails: writes a link in a form this snapshot does not read
